race.comment: PINAMILLOY (8) brings the strongest exposed profile, having placed in all three starts and twice from two attempts around 1000m. His close second at Cranbourne on heavy ground and third at Ballarat Synthetic before the break read well for this, and three trials since, including a close second at Sandown-Hillside, suggest he is forward enough to take beating. CAPITAL STORM (5) was beaten as a well-supported favourite on debut at Sale, though he may not have handled the track. He's jumped out well since and Lane going on is a big push for his chances. Can make a statement. A STERN ANGEL (2) is the key debut runner after winning a Flemington trial for the Hayes boys, whose first-starter record gives him a solid base. Drawn well and won't be far away. KENSINGTON (12) can feature on debut with the aid of an inside barrier.
